gloss: tears of gratitude; tears of deep emotion

definitions.gloss: tears of deep emotion; tears of gratitude
definitions.explanation: Tears shed because one is deeply moved, by gratitude, joy or admiration. A written, somewhat literary word, common in headlines and formal speech.

examples.english: To be choked with tears of emotion.

examples.japanese: ⟦{恩師|おんし}→恩師：12598_onshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{感涙|かんるい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was moved to tears by my former teacher's words.

examples.japanese: {三十年|さんじゅうねん}ぶり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}→再会：11667_saikai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{兄弟|きょうだい}→兄弟：00964_kyoudai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{抱|だ}き{合|あ}って→抱き合う：32504_dakiau⟧{感涙|かんるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}した→流す：01968_nagasu⟧。
examples.english: The brothers, reunited after thirty years, embraced and shed tears of emotion.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {感涙|かんるい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧むせぶ: to be choked with tears of emotion (a set phrase)
- {感涙|かんるい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{流|なが}す→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to shed tears of emotion
- {感涙|かんるい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be moved to tears
- {感涙|かんるい}もの: something that moves one to tears (informal, often jokingly: {感涙|かんるい}もの⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{美味|おい}しさ)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}し{涙|なみだ}→嬉し涙：34045_ureshinamida⟧: tears of joy (everyday word)
- ⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧: tears of emotion (the everyday way to say it)
